title: ScrapeBench measures policy compliance by AI web agents
summary: Agent behavior was measured in one-request website tasks under different policy and prompt conditions; comparisons are limited to this benchmark setup. The results do not establish legal liability or behavior across all websites, tasks or deployed settings.
ai_technology: AI web agents’ actions on a benchmark of websites with labeled scraping policies were evaluated against human behavior.
organization: Pivotal Research; University of Bath; National University of the Philippines; University of Notre Dame; Hebrew University of Jerusalem
